commitments.detail: Ensure all safety protocols are followed during temporary operations.
Isolate and repair P-2 as soon as possible.
Ensure all safety protocols are followed during installation of temporary chiller.
Coordinate with Process Engineering to minimize downtime and ensure reactor suite can complete its batch.
Ensure all safety protocols are followed during installation of temporary chiller.
Install temporary chiller within 8 hours and ensure it meets required specifications.
Schedule immediate repair of P-2 pump.
Adjust reactor suite batch timing to minimize impact.
Ensure temporary chiller meets all safety and operational standards.
